Short blonde hair pulled straight back frames an oval face with moderately prominent cheekbones, a rounded chin, and a moderately defined jawline. The subject has soft-arched medium eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelid creases and a slight upward slant, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. The forehead is moderately high and wide with slight temporal recession, the mouth is of medium width with level corners and visible upper teeth, and the ears have free lobes.
